name: MTGSimManu
tagline: A Modern Magic: The Gathering simulator with an EV-driven AI and a rules engine that audits itself.
credits: Engine shell by ManusAI · strategy, EV scoring, rules programme and outputs by Claude · owned by DJPieter81

legacy.title: MTGSimClaude — the Legacy sister project
legacy.body: 38 Legacy decks at about 2.5 ms per game with per-deck strategy functions. The two projects share the clock evaluator, Bayesian hand inference, the strategic logger and declarative gameplans.
